milestones.title: Explain reviewer output-cap failures without changing vote or salvage semantics
acceptance_criteria: Implement capHit and capLimitClause in internal/mission/quorum/run.go per design Decisions 1–3; cap detection runs only after ParseReviewResult fails, preserves recordInvalid, and names out.Model rather than the provider API name.

Row a: empty raw/reason at 65536 of 65536 is absent invalid with nil salvage and error containing truncated, inferred, 65536, quoted oc-glm-5-3, and max_output_tokens; kill deletion of the inferred disjunct.
Row a2: empty raw/reason at 65537 of 65536 reports truncated at 65537; kill replacement of >= with ==.

Row b: cut-off reject with length at 65536 of 65536 reports finish_reason=length, reported by provider, consumed the declared max_output_tokens (65536), and salvages reject; separately kill deletion of the length disjunct and a hardcoded inferred label.

Row b2: cut-off reject with length at 40000 of 65536 reports below the declared max_output_tokens (65536) and provider-side or context-window limit, excludes consumed, and salvages reject; kill dropping capLimitClause's n >= budget check.

Row b3: cut-off reject with length at 16384 and cheapModel cap 0 reports declares no max_output_tokens and excludes consumed/below the declared; kill deletion of the consumed-clause budget > 0 conjunct.
Row c: malformed verdict prefix with stop at 65536 of 65536 retains the exact ParseReviewResult error and excludes truncated; kill deletion of FinishReason == empty from inference.
Row d: malformed verdict prefix with empty reason at 65535 of 65536 excludes truncated; kill deletion of the OutputTokens >= budget comparison.
Row f: malformed verdict prefix with empty reason at 20 and cheapModel cap 0 excludes truncated; kill deletion of the inference budget > 0 guard.
Row e: valid pass JSON with empty reason at 65536 of 65536 stays present with empty absence/error and Result.Verdict pass; kill moving cap rejection ahead of parsing.

All nine rows reside in new internal/mission/quorum/cap_hit_test.go, use stubCaller and outcome model oc-glm-5-3, and use cappedModel derived from cheapModel with MaxOutputTokens 65536 except explicit zero-cap rows.
Demonstrate every listed mutation fails its matching row in a scratch source copy; restore between mutants and remove scratch files before final validation.
Existing TestRunReviewerWith_TruncatedOutputFailsLoudly and TestSalvageProduction pass unmodified; AbsentReason remains invalid and salvage behavior is preserved.
Create changelogs/unreleased/2026-10-27-quorum-reviewer-cap-hit-loud.md beginning with a ### Fixed — section describing the diagnostic fix without recommending a budget change.
go test ./internal/mission/quorum/... passes.
go vet ./internal/mission/quorum/... passes.
gofmt -l internal/mission/quorum/ prints nothing.
make check-changelog passes with the new fragment.
Premise (g): run grep -c 'FinishReason' internal/ai/ollama/client.go and record its count; base prints 0 with expected grep exit 1; inspect and document any changed premise without editing providers.
Premise (h): run grep -n 'Model:' internal/mission/quorum/call.go and grep -n 'out := &ReviewerOutcome' internal/mission/quorum/run.go; confirm request c.handler.Model() and outcome Model: modelID.
Label socket-bind or outside-worktree-write failures UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX with evidence rather than assigning a pass/fail verdict.
No internal/ai/** edits, no models.yml edits, no call.go budget/thinking changes, and no seating or mission gate policy changes.
milestones.evidence: All nine cap-hit rows and existing truncation/salvage tests pass; all 10 specified mutants fail their matching assertions (exit 1), with cmp-verified restoration after each. Final go test, go vet, gofmt -l (empty), and make check-changelog exit 0 (5 valid fragments). Premise (g): FinishReason count 0, expected grep exit 1. Premise (h): call.go:44 uses c.handler.Model(); run.go:113 retains Model: modelID. Decision 1 uses hit = because hit is a named return variable.
